name: Trockenheit von Merkua
original_name: トロッケンハイト・フォン・メルクーア
source:
Third year student from "Moon Academy", and one of the candidate for this year's μ. She's the successor of 双鉗（ミリアーデ), the current winning force at the three magic factors' war.

Due to her cold and merciless way of acting, she's being feared as the Empress of Moon Academy.
